description: One item by type, city and slug: a question with its best answer and the count of further answers, a missed-connection post, a recommendation, a classified, a blog post or a business listing. Use it after a search or browse result when the user wants more on one item. Limitation: text is a summary of up to about 600 characters; contact details are never included and are on the linked page.

city.description: City slug from the result, or "global" for blog posts without a city

slug.description: The slug at the end of the item url

name: get_item
title: Get one item
